pictures.name: ZNS1-Purple-Cargo
pictures.prompt: An ancient Greek merchant ship under a square sail on a deep blue sea around 300 BCE, its deck stacked with bales of cloth dyed rich royal purple and clay jars. At the rail stands Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, in a merchant’s tunic, looking proudly at his cargo. Bright gold sunlight, white-capped waves. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: ZNS2-The-Wreck
pictures.prompt: A storm at night off a rocky Greek coast around 300 BCE: an ancient merchant ship breaks apart against the rocks, its square sail torn, bales of purple cloth tumbling into the dark waves and swirls of purple dye spreading in the foam. No people in danger shown. Lightning, deep blue and violet, dramatic but painterly. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: ZNS3-Ashore
pictures.prompt: Dawn on a quiet rocky beach near the harbor of Athens around 300 BCE. Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, sits alone on a rock, soaked, in a torn salt-stained tunic, with nothing in his hands. Far off, on a hill, the temples of Athens catch the first light. Grey-pink dawn, gentle waves, a stillness after the storm. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: ZNS4-Bookshop
pictures.prompt: A small bookseller’s shop in ancient Athens, shelves of scroll pigeonholes, a striped awning, the street bright outside. An old bookseller with a white beard sits reading aloud from an open scroll. On a stool before him, Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, still in his salt-stained tunic, listens, leaning forward. Warm gold light through the doorway, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
